VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are heading to the International Space Station to train astronauts for spacewalks in collaboration with the European Space Agency.

VR.title: This Quest Accessory Wants to Turn Your Brain Activity Into VR Avatar Control
VR.summary: PiEEG is launching a brain-computer interface for Quest headsets, enabling real-time avatar control via brain signals and facial micro-expressions.

VR.title: Valve Released A (Flatscreen) 4K Steam Link visionOS App
VR.summary: Valve has released a native visionOS client for Steam Link, supporting 4K 120FPS, eliminating the need for the previous iPad app.

VR.title: KRVR Supports Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming For SteamVR Games
VR.summary: KRVR app enables Apple Vision Pro users to play SteamVR games with foveated streaming, enhancing the gaming experience on the new headset.

VR.title: James Cameron’s 3D Studio Acquires 3D Camera Maker STEREOTEC
VR.summary: James Cameron’s Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC, aiming to integrate its technology into future projects.

VR.title: ‘No Man’s Sky’ Brings Its Biggest Space Battles to Date in ‘The Swarm’ Update
VR.summary: No Man's Sky's latest update, 'The Swarm,' introduces massive space battles and community objectives as it prepares for its 10th anniversary.

AI.title: Microsoft’s first advanced reasoning AI is here
AI.summary: Microsoft unveiled its first advanced reasoning AI model, MAI-Thinking-1, at Build 2026, marking a significant step in its AI development.

AI.title: Microsoft Scout is a new AI personal assistant built on OpenClaw
AI.summary: Microsoft introduced Scout, an AI personal assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 apps, enhancing productivity for businesses.

AI.title: Google must let publishers opt out of AI Search features, rules UK
AI.summary: A UK regulatory ruling mandates Google to allow online publishers to opt out of its AI Search features, increasing content control.

AI.title: Microsoft Build 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
AI.summary: Microsoft Build 2026 showcased major announcements, including new hardware and updates to in-house AI models, led by CEO Satya Nadella.

AI.title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
AI.summary: Google's Phone app will now alert users to potential AI impersonation scams, enhancing security against fraudulent calls.

AI.title: Microsoft’s Project Solara is an OS for AI agent gadgets
AI.summary: Microsoft announced 'Project Solara,' a new OS for AI agent gadgets, designed to power agent-driven experiences.

NFL.summary: Drake London signed a four-year, $141 million extension, making him the third-highest paid receiver in the league.

NFL.title: Dolphins sign 10 of their draft picks
NFL.summary: The Dolphins have signed 10 of their 2026 draft picks in a flurry of activity to finalize their roster.

NFL.title: Sean McVay: If Aaron Donald is interested in a return, Rams are interested
NFL.summary: Sean McVay expressed interest in Aaron Donald's potential return to the Rams, following Donald's recent comments on his future.

NFL.summary: The Eagles attempted to acquire Myles Garrett from the Browns, but Cleveland opted for a trade that included Jalen Carter.

NFL.title: Report: Roger Goodell will "politely decline" invitation to testify on Sport Broadcasting Act
NFL.summary: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell will decline an invitation to testify regarding the Sports Broadcasting Act, according to reports.

NFL.title: Nick Herbig agrees to four-year extension with Steelers
NFL.summary: Nick Herbig has agreed to a four-year extension with the Steelers, securing his future with the team.
